description: Fix 3 scoring bugs (engagement velocity, volume turnover, EV for tokens above targets) and add rug detection module with pipeline integration.
steps: Fix engagement velocity: ensure reply_count and created_timestamp are correctly extracted from token_data (Pump.fun format) with millisecond handling
Fix volume turnover: add scoring thresholds below 0.1 so low-but-nonzero ratios like 0.005 get a low score instead of 0
Fix EV for tokens above all targets: extend probability targets to include 10M, 50M, 100M, 300M for mature tokens. Show 'Mature - no probability-based edge' when no further targets apply
Create memescanner/rug_detector.py with RugDetector class implementing all red/green flag signals
Integrate rug detection into the filter/scoring pipeline in main.py
Add tests for rug detector and updated scoring/probability logic
acceptance_criteria: Engagement velocity shows non-zero for tokens with reply_count > 0
Volume turnover shows non-zero score for any non-zero volume/MC ratio
EV shows meaningful values or 'Mature' message for tokens above all standard targets
Rug detector returns rug_probability, risk_label, red_flags, green_flags, verdict
Tokens with rug_probability > 0.7 get warning, > 0.85 get rejected
findings: All 109 tests pass (29 new tests added). Bug 1: created_timestamp=0 was being treated as epoch (1970), giving 496k hours age. Fixed by treating 0 and pre-2020 timestamps as invalid. Bug 2: volume_to_mcap_ratio of 0.005 was scoring 0 because threshold was 0.1. Added sub-thresholds at 0.01 (score 5) and 0.01-0.1 (score 15). Bug 3: EV was $0 for tokens above 5M. Added extended targets (10M, 50M, 100M, 300M) with lower base rates. Pump.fun API tested live - returns num_participants=0 for many tokens and reply_count varies.
